text:
deploy-bot: config-only deploy initiated by @ashwin for service=router-worker

deploy-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/services/pull/3421
deploy-bot: change-window 2024-07-18T02:00:00Z..2024-07-18T03:00:00Z

ashwin: rolling out routing policy + batching tweaks. main changes:
- route weighting: tenant-slow -> 0.6
- tenant-fast -> 0.4
- batch_size_target: 32 -> 24
- idle_timeout_ms: 150 -> 200

ashwin: will canary to 5% for first 10m, then 20% for 20m if stable.

maria: ack. will add a release-notes blurb. also set alert on p50>120ms or error% >0.5% :eyes:

leo: observability check: ensure kvcache hit rate doesn't drop under 90% in canary. set temporary dashboard tile.

ops-jen: rollback criteria: p95 latency +10% over baseline for 3 consecutive 1m buckets OR error rate >1% for 2 consecutive mins. If triggered, immediate pinback to previous config and open rollback playbook.

ashwin: agreed. adding feature-flag gating in case we need hard cut: `config.stage=off`

devx-max: heads-up for SDK teams — batching change might affect logspam for small requests. Will publish note in #devx.

maria: release notes draft:
```
Config-only: adjust routing weights and reduce default batch target to improve fairness for tenant-slow. Idle timeout increased to reduce cold-start CPU churn. Canary rollout: 5% -> 20%. Rollback if latency or errors regress.
```

leo: deploybot canary update: canary deployed to 5% (10 hosts). telemetry baseline started.

deploy-bot: healthcheck: all canary hosts green, avg p50=95ms (baseline 92ms), error% 0.08%.

maria: good. push to 20% after 12m if no alerts.

ashwin: monitoring note: throttling buckets adjusted, token bucket refilled to avoid headroom issues. test sweep passing locally.

leo: KV cache didn't change; hit rate 93% on canary. No regression.

ops-jen: keep eyeballs for next 15m. if we see p50 creep toward 130ms escalate to #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: ramped to 20% at 2024-07-18T02:22:00Z. monitoring window started.

deploy-bot: final status: rollout complete to 100% at 2024-07-18T02:45:30Z. No rollback triggered.

ashwin: will post postmortem if any later anomalies; closing thread for now. :party_parrot:
